using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end


function dotprod_b_cuda_mr(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            loss[1] = loss[1] + mapreduce((__mr_1, __mr_2)->__mr_1 * __mr_2, +, u, v)
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __cse_0 = lossb[1]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * __cse_0
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * __cse_0
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_b_cuda_atomic(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end



function bench(f, args, n)
    f(args...); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time(); for _ in 1:n; f(args...); end; CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time() - t0) / n * 1e6
end
function main()
    N = 4096
    u = CUDA.CuArray(collect(1.0:N) ./ N); ub = CUDA.zeros(Float64, N)
    v = CUDA.CuArray(fill(2.0, N));        vb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, N)
    loss = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64, 1)
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()), "n" => N)
    truth = sum(Array(u) .* Array(v))
    r["truth"] = truth
    for (nm, f) in (("mapreduce", dotprod_b_cuda_mr), ("atomic", dotprod_b_cuda_atomic))
        fill!(loss, 0.0); fill!(ub, 0.0); fill!(vb, 0.0)
        try
            f(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, N); CUDA.synchronize()
            got = Array(loss)[1]
            r[nm * "_loss"] = got
            r[nm * "_relerr"] = abs(got - truth) / abs(truth)
            r[nm * "_us"] = round(bench(f, (loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, N), 500), digits = 2)
        catch e
            r[nm * "_status"] = "ERR: " * first(sprint(showerror, e), 150)
        end
    end
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
